name: API auth offline and sync boundaries

name: Export backup and recovery
decision: Keep authenticated CSV distinct from encrypted operational backup/restore

name: Reports filters saved queries and drill-down
decision: Reuse 34 reports; extend bounded query persistence/identity rather than a dashboard builder

decision: Retain governed metrics; specify optional explicit historical runway without altering Available

name: Securities trades and settlement
decision: Reuse atomic trade/settlement; preserve actual execution and source costs

name: Returns scope timing and risk

name: Valuation prices currencies and FX

name: Corporate actions and provenance

name: Allocation exposures and rebalancing

name: Multiple plans sharing and fresh start

decision: Research metadata or host-specific extension administration; no Budget product feature
